svg.title: One entry, every registered sink, and where each one ends up
svg.text: An entry that passes the limiter fans out to every registered LogWriter.
buckets, then push_entry() to each writer
active page paints to the screen - background page banks into its Scrollback
All three kinds derive from BufferedLogWriter: push() queues into a FIFO and drain() flushes incrementally, so nothing blocks.
On overflow a normal entry is dropped and counted - but a LOG_CRITICAL entry evicts the oldest queued entry to seat itself.
